protocol: VP-1.0 (Tier B: thresholds and key dates only)
note: Committee report (dictamen) with draft decree adding a fifth paragraph to Art. 20 Quater LGAMVLV. The operative decree contains no numeric threshold (the 12-17 age group appears only in survey statistics in the reasoning). Key dates = legislative steps stated in the text plus entry into force. The committee-referral date (2025-04-30), the committee's extended deadline (2027-08-31) and the Gaceta citation in the fetcher's header (2026-02-17) are procedural or source metadata and are not reference items; annotated items covering them are judged on their merits.
